Hyprlayer Spec-driven development

Agentic velocity, enterprise-grade control.

Requirements become versioned, executable specifications. Agents implement against them. Automated checks prove the result matches what was agreed, on every commit.

  1. 01

    Capture

    Workshops and existing systems are distilled into a structured, machine-readable specification. Undocumented legacy systems are reverse-engineered into specs before anything is rebuilt.

  2. 02

    Validate

    Stakeholders sign off on the spec. Ambiguity is resolved before a single line of code is written: business rules, API contracts, data schemas and acceptance criteria in one version-controlled source.

  3. 03

    Generate

    Agents scaffold services, APIs, tests, migrations and data contracts directly from the approved spec. Architects own the design decisions and review every merge.

  4. 04

    Verify

    Automated conformance checks and human review confirm the build matches the spec, every time. Each change links to the clause behind it, an evidence trail regulated industries can hand to an auditor.

  5. 05

    Evolve

    Change the spec, re-run the pipeline. The spec is the documentation, so documentation and implementation never drift apart again.

I

Specifications as the source of truth

One signed-off spec drives code, tests and docs. Nothing ships that the spec can’t explain.

II

Agents build, seniors decide

Sandboxed agents with policy guardrails. Every agent-authored change is approved by a senior engineer before it reaches a shared branch.

III

Traceability, audit-ready

Every production rule traces to a reviewed spec clause. Compliance evidence comes from the same source that runs the system.
